desc: Ruger's Stock Module, Low Comb/Compact Length of Pull, fits Ruger American Rimfire, 10/22 and any other Ruger rifle with the Modular Stock System. This comb is intended for use with standard iron sights. The low comb height allows for the ideal placement of the shooter's cheek in line with the sights. It has the compact length of pull. Genuine Ruger Factory Accessory. 1.26" Comb Height, 12.5" Length of Pull.
